newsitem.title: GAMBIA: Guinea Bissau president names new prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Guinea Bissau president names new prime minister.

text.p: Guinea Bissau's President Joao Bernardo Viera has named Carlos Correia as new prime minister, to replace Manuel Saturnino Costa who was sacked last week, Bissau Radio said on Friday.
The radio, monitored in nearby Gambia, said Viera dissolved the government on May 26 because of its failure to resolve Guinea Bissau's economic crisis. Correia was prime minister from 1991 to 1994.
